description_en: We have a 3+1+3 apartment for sale in the Dry Lake area. Property information: • Net area: 203 m² • Floor: 5 • Orientation: East – West • New construction, with elevator Layout: • Spacious living and cooking area • 3 bedrooms • 3 bathrooms • Laundry • Wardrobe • Veranda Other settings: • Fully invested apartment • Functional fireplace • Modern furnishing carefully realized in every detail • Night lighting with blue LED in the entire apartment • Toilets with chromotherapy system • Thermal and acoustic insulation throughout the apartment • Central underfloor heating system • Triplex windows • Quality parquet • Air conditioning system • Possibility of parking with extra price • Regular mortgage documentation For more information or for a visit to the property, please contact us.
